subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add first-class all-message Space ingestion via user OAuth or Workspace Events, or should it remain service-account HTTP-webhook and mention-gated for now?
rationale: The remaining request is not a narrow adapter bug: it adds credential-bearing auth, Google event subscription delivery, security expectations, and user-facing setup/config surface for an alpha channel plugin.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned all-message design
options.body: Implement this inside the Google Chat plugin with explicit scopes, SecretRef/redaction support, event subscription lifecycle, docs, fallback behavior, and live Workspace proof.

options.title: Split remaining auth work to the OAuth issue
options.body: Track user OAuth primitives under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9764 and keep this issue focused on Space all-message ingestion once the auth model is accepted.

options.title: Defer all-message ingestion
options.body: Keep Google Chat service-account webhooks mention-gated and document the limitation until maintainers decide the setup and security cost is worth it.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned all-message design
recommendation.body: Implement this inside the Google Chat plugin with explicit scopes, SecretRef/redaction support, event subscription lifecycle, docs, fallback behavior, and live Workspace proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing signal from Google Chat thread-reply history, auth/API refactors, and prior maintainer-side review context on the overlapping OAuth issue.
